metadata.title: Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) | We Grow Brands
metadata.description: Answers to frequently asked questions about our website packages, hosting, process and support.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: These are the most common questions. Can't find your answer?

speed.q: How quickly can my website go live?
speed.a: Usually within 2 to 4 weeks, depending on complexity and how quickly we receive content.

type.q: What kind of websites do you make?
type.a: We create premium custom websites: from landing pages and business websites to portfolios and webshops. Always with a focus on branding and conversion.

redesign.q: Can I have my current website redesigned?
redesign.a: Yes, we'd love to help with a redesign or complete makeover of your existing website. We look at what works and what can be improved.

installments.a: Yes. You pay a down payment and then 6 monthly installments. After 7 months you're the full owner of your website.

ownership.q: When do I become the owner of my website?
ownership.a: After the down payment and 6 monthly installments (7 months total) you're 100% owner. Your website is then completely yours.

leaseVsInstallments.q: What's the difference between installments and website lease?
leaseVsInstallments.a: With installments, the website becomes fully your property after 7 months and mandatory payments stop. With lease, you keep paying every month, even when nothing happens to your website - you're never the owner and you're stuck in a lock-in. We believe in fair deals: building a beautiful, high-quality website that becomes yours, without endless payments. After 7 months you're completely free: you can choose optional packages like hosting, maintenance or changes - all at your own discretion.

nonPayment.q: What happens if I miss an installment payment?
nonPayment.a: You'll receive one reminder. If the payment isn't made within 7 days, the website goes offline. This is the only way to offer flexible payment options. Having payment issues? Always contact us in advance, so we can think along about a solution.

stopPayment.q: Can I stop paying during the term?
stopPayment.a: No, the full amount must always be paid. You can't stop after a few months. If you fall behind on payments the website goes offline, but the payment obligation remains.

hostingIncluded.a: We recommend having hosting & maintenance with us, but you're free to choose your own hosting provider. All packages include 6 months of hosting.

hostingRequired.q: Am I required to take hosting and maintenance from you?
hostingRequired.a: No, you're not required to take hosting and maintenance from us. After full payment, the website is yours and you can choose where to host. We do recommend hosting with us, as we can then guarantee your website stays fast, secure and up-to-date. If you host elsewhere, we cannot be responsible for the technical performance, speed or security of your website.

externalHosting.q: What if I want to host my website elsewhere?
externalHosting.a: That's fine, you're completely free in your choice. Keep in mind that we can't guarantee the same technical speed, uptime and security. With external hosting, we are not responsible for how the website functions. We hand over the website properly, but after that the responsibility lies with you or your hosting party.

hostingPackages.q: What hosting packages do you offer?
hostingPackages.a: We have different packages: hosting only (from €14.50/month with AI-optimized optimizations), hosting with maintenance, or hosting with maintenance and regular changes (from €39.95/month). You choose what suits you.

hostingBenefits.q: What are the benefits of hosting with you?
hostingBenefits.a: With us you get 99.9% uptime, fast loading times, daily backups, SSL certificate and technical maintenance. We keep your website secure and up-to-date. If something goes wrong, we fix it. With external hosting, you're responsible for all these things yourself.

process.q: How does the process from design to launch work?
process.a: The process follows clear steps: 1) Introduction and briefing - we discuss your wishes, goals and audience. 2) Strategy and structure - we determine the layout and page structure. 3) Design - we create the visual design based on your branding. 4) Feedback and revisions - you provide feedback and we process changes. 5) Development - we build the website technically. 6) Content and finishing - texts and images are placed. 7) Launch - your website goes live after your approval.

feedbackRounds.q: How many feedback rounds are there?
feedbackRounds.a: There are always 2 feedback rounds included. We provide clear information upfront, and we expect concrete feedback from you. This way we can keep the price attractive for this quality. Extra rounds are possible at additional cost.

extraFeatures.q: What if I want extra pages or features later?
extraFeatures.a: No problem. We can expand whenever you grow, from extra pages to custom functionality.

selfEdit.q: Can I edit content myself after delivery?
selfEdit.a: With the Growth and Essentials packages you get access to a user-friendly dashboard where you can edit texts and images yourself. Note: if you break something and don't have a maintenance package, there are costs involved.

otherServices.a: Yes, besides web design we also offer branding (logo, brand identity, visual identity), copywriting, SEO optimization, photography and videography, social media content and strategy. We can support your brand from A to Z, tailored to your stage and audience. Also check out our add-ons on the packages page.

supportAfter.q: How does support work after delivery?
supportAfter.a: We remain available for maintenance, optimization and expansions. You're not locked in, but you are in good hands.

responseTime.q: How quickly do you respond to questions?
responseTime.a: We respond as quickly as we can. For urgent matters, we're also reachable via WhatsApp.
